d: Samrat Choudhary on Nitish Setu : bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne nitish setu ke lokarpan karyakram ke dauran postar-bainar vivad par vipaksh ko javab diya... pradhanmantri narendr modi ne shanivar ko vaishali men kachchi dargah-bidupur ke bich bane siks len pul ka udghatan kiya... janasbha ko sanbodhit karte hue samrat chaudhri ne kaha ki postar men nitish kumar ki tasvir nahin hone ki bat uthaee ja rahi hai, lekin pura pul hi nitishmay ho gaya hai... unhonne vipaksh par nishana sadhte hue kaha ki pradhanmantri narendr modi ke netritv men 2047 tak viksit bharat ka sapna hai aur…
